beta.notes:
New in this version:
• New work samples now use a four-square header. Choose four-square or six-square in Settings > Grading & output > PDF output. Completed samples keep their original format.
• The folder setup message now explains why it can appear after using Buddy for a while, with calmer wording, clearer choices, and folder details available separately.

Fixes:
• Editing a completed sample now correctly finds workspace-relative source backups and fills in the student and course header fields.

stable.notes:
Fixes:
• Fixed the sample verification window reporting "All fields verified" when the date box was still empty. An automatically read date was stamped on the sample and counted as checked without ever being shown, so it could be saved without anyone seeing it.
